_note: Hand-written annotations for OPERATOR-TABLE.md (task T28), FACT-SRC from Compiler.cs (VisitBinaryExpression/VisitUnaryExpression), Binders.cs (PSBinaryOperationBinder, PSUnaryOperationBinder) and parserutils.cs (ParserOps). Keys are TokenKind names; 'groups' give shared text.

add: null + x gives x; numeric + numeric uses the wider type with overflow to double; numeric + string converts the string to a number (Parser.ScanNumber); string + any (and char + any) concatenates using the right operand's string form; array/enumerable + x appends (array concatenation); hashtable + hashtable merges, hashtable + other is an error; otherwise a user-defined op_Addition
sub: numeric (wider type, overflow to double); string left operand converted to number; otherwise op_Subtraction
mul: null * x is null; numeric; numeric * string converts the string; string * n repeats the string; array/enumerable * n repeats the elements; otherwise op_Multiply
div: null / x treats null as 0; int/int gives an int when the division is exact, otherwise a double; division by zero raises a RuntimeException; string operands converted to numbers; otherwise op_Division
rem: null % x treats null as 0; integer remainder; remainder by zero raises a RuntimeException; otherwise op_Modulus
shift: integer shift; operand type int, uint, long or ulong chosen from the wider operand
bitwise: integer bitwise operation on int, uint, long or ulong chosen from the wider operand
logical: AndAlso/OrElse over bool conversions (-and, -or); NotEqual over two bools (-xor)
operands converted with PowerShell truthiness (IsTrue); -and/-or short-circuit; -xor evaluates both
cmp_eq: Dynamic site PSBinaryOperationBinder(Equal/NotEqual) with ignore-case flag (i-variants and the plain operator ignore case, c-variants do not)

null handling; enumerable left operand filters (returns matching elements) unless scalar compare; string left operand: ordinal-culture string compare with right operand converted to string; char left operand ignoring case; numeric compare; otherwise Equals, then Equals after converting the right operand to the left operand's type (an InvalidCast gives false)
cmp_ord: same dispatch as equality; non-numeric left operands use LanguagePrimitives.Compare (right operand converted to the left type; left operand must be comparable)
like: wildcard match; array left operand filters; constant right operand pre-built to a WildcardPattern
match: ParserOps.MatchOperator(context, position, left, right, notMatch, ignoreCase)
regex match; scalar left operand sets $Matches (hashtable, case-insensitive keys; numeric group names become int keys); array left operand filters elements
replace: right operand is an array of 1..2 elements (pattern, replacement); replacement string or script block (MatchEvaluator); more than 2 elements is an error
split: ParserOps.SplitOperator / UnarySplitOperator(context, position, left, right, ignoreCase)
regex split by default (SimpleMatch option for literal); optional limit and options; predicate script block form; unary form splits on whitespace
join: joins elements converted to strings with the separator; unary form joins with an empty separator
contains: GenerateCallContains: ParserOps.ContainsOperatorCompiled with enumerator site and Equal binary site (scalar compare)
collection membership by PowerShell equality; -in/-notin swap the operands; -notcontains/-notin negate
is: TypeOps.IsInstance / TypeIs on the base object; -isnot negates
right operand is a type; PSObject/PSCustomObject special cases
format: string.Format with the right operand as arguments (array elements spread)
range: integer ranges up and down; single-character operands give a character range
unary_arith: unary plus and minus are implemented as binary add/subtract from 0
incdec: prefix returns the new value; postfix returns the old value (null postfix result is 0); needs an assignable operand
assign: = stores; op= applies the dynamic binary operation to the current value then stores; ??= stores only when the current value is $null
special: member access, static member access, invocation/call/dot-source; no expression-tree operator
redirect: stream redirection, not an expression operator
